with the girls. Prof. Drummond led chapel & talked about "Come unto me, & I will give you rest" +c. Classes- swept - dusted room. Went rowing with Miss Townsend, Ruthie & Simon. Letter from Mrs. Booth. Darned stockings & read Independent in evening. 
Sun. 16 Prof. Borone preached at College. Missionary in evening. Rev. Thos. Snell Smith & a native from Ceylon. Went to church & Young People's Meeting in Village. Read speeches at [?Ann Broad?] Meeting in Independent. Prayermeeting led by Miss Byington
Mon. 17 Lovely weather. Mended & read in A.M. and then tried to nurse invalid Cassius Canis. Walked to Natick & back in P.M. No entertainment in evening - read some of Dana's Corals & Coral Islands. 
Tues. 18 Classes as usual. Faculty Meeting in evening. Miss Shafer presided - Letter from Prof. Niles & Prof. Starr - wrote to Prof. Starr about the Sodium volcano. Did not go to the W.C.T.U. Convention - talked with Carrie Soule about Kent Dunlop and Nisba Breckenridge. Miss M.E.B. Roberts called, & spoke about the Salem position. 
Wed. 19 Sat for pictures at 9 A.M. Simon went

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
with me, and had some taken also. After much discussion, Marion Marsh and I took 12:15 train for Boston to call on Mr. Carrigan about the Salem position - found him in his office, 6 Ashburton Place, & gave him Miss Eaton's name, which he refused to consider particularly - he suggested that we apply for the place - came out at 2:15, & taught my 3:10 class. Prayermeeting in the evening. Miss Shafer - Meeting of Chairmen of Bible Committees after it. Wrote to Mr. Carrigan - Lottie wrote to Gen Walker.
Thurs. 20 Classes all day, & office hour. Went to Stone Hall before chapel - & out with Prof. Niles & the Geol. class from 4-4:30. Uncle Sam, Furben & wife were here today - saws them from 11:45-1:30. After prayermeeing (Miss Case.) Miss Barrows, Miss Middlekauff & I made calls on Miss VanVleck, Mdlle. Pelissier, [[?]] Wenckenbach - Mrs. Torrey - Miss Burrell,  Miss Pendleton - Letter from home - Pater gone to Chicago -
Fri. 21 Bad headache. Bible Class - Went to Village after shoes - came back with Miss Conley & Miss Gilchrist - made fir pillows - did not go to Village in evening.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sat. 22 Classes as usual. Helped sweep room. corrected problems. read Geology _+c Mr. Powers read in evening. David Garrick, Ethel went - not I - admission 25 cents. Beautiful moonlight in evening. Letter from home.
Sun. 23. Fine weather. Rev. Fred Palmer preached at College. Mr. Hillyer spoke at 3 on the work of the Church Temperance Societies of the Episcopal Church. 5 oclock meeting led by Helen Pierce. Union Prayer meeting of Freshmen in Stone Hall Parlor, led by Miss Chandler. Went with Miss Emerson to church in village. Rev. Lucius Eastman preached.
Mon. 24 Finished up the fir pillow & sent it off to Mrs. Booth. Studied Volcanoes +c. Went with ethel to dentist in Newton in P.M. back at 4:28. Concert in evening by Listermann String Quartette - did not go - Made questions & problems. Wrote letter to pater.
Tues. 25 Written lessons at 9:00 & 1:30. Miss Howes & a lady from the Sandwich Islands were in the Geology class, not my pleasure, especially as the lesson was on Coral Islands & Volcanoes. I went to bed after it. read Judith Shakepere.
Wed. 26 Did not go to breakfast or dinner. Kept office hour, & taught my two classes in P.M.
Thurs. 27 Classes & Office hour as usual. Business
                           (letter from Miss Hosford)

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
meeting of Christian Association in evening reports of Committees.
Fri. 28 Classes. Ten Commandments in Bible Class. Bible Com. Meeting at 4. Carrie Soule & I went to the Village after dinner. 
Sat. 29 Went to Boston at 12:15 leaving Simon to attend to the Written Lesson of the 3:10 chem class. Head Geo. W. Cable teach the Sunday School lesson at Tremont Temple - bought things to put in Halloween Cake for table - Wrote to Miss Hosford in evening. Went with Simon to see Mrs Hanks who is to make the cake. Pres. gates of Rutgers College, lectured on Sidney Lanier - we heard the last part of it, which was delightful. 
Sun. 30 Corrected examination papers. Letter from Marshall Ballington Booth. Had lunch at 11:30, & took 12:15 train with Misses Algor, Beau & Biscoe for Newton Center - went on a geological tramp with Prof. Niles - back at 4:28 - fine time - Halloween festivities this evening - Cake at table - Beautiful weather - Carrie Waters called while I was gone.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Tues. Nov. 1 Fine cold weather. Classes as usual. Went down to Mrs Manley's with Ethel in P.M. also to Miss Moulton's - did not find her at home - Faculty Meeting in evening & lunch thereafter. Great S.S. Meeting in Boston today.
Wed. 2 Went with Ethel to Miss Moulton, whom we found today. Kept office hours profusely for bad chemistry children. Classes at 1:30 and 3:10. Wrote letter home - also one to Jack - note to Mrs Wood.
Thurs. 3. Classes all day as usual. Prayer meeting led by Miss Denis.
Fri. 4 Bible class. Meeting of Norumbega Fund Comm. at 3:10, after wh. Miss Montague & I went to see Katherine at Stone Hall. Then we went to see Mrs. Durant at her house - staid until 6:20 & lost our dinner. I had something to eat at Simpson with Anne Montague. fell into a ditch on the way home - Lilla D. Patterson was here with her husband, father in law & mother in law - left on 12:15 train.
Sat. 5 Kate Kelsey here. Lilla arrived about 10. Alumnae meeting at 3. my class met at 2:20 instead of 3:10. Swept & dusted room in evening.
Sun. 6 Lovely weather. went to church & Sunday School in village in A.M. walked with Simon to

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Wellesley Hills to church in afternoon. Prayer meeting here in 144 this evening. Florence Dean led. Prof. Tucker of Andover, preached at College today. Katherine came up after chapel to tell me about their interview with Miss Feeman.
Mon. 7 Wrote to pater, Harl & Harry, Uncle Herbert, Abby Brooks, Louis Langford, Dora Freeman, Edith Metcalf. Miss Hocker took written lesson. Piano Concert in evening - Gathering o Alumnae in #144.
Tues. 8 Wrote to Alma Wright, & again to Louise Langford. Classes as usual. We four chemicals went to the Paint Mill in afternoon, with Mrs. Wood. Election Day. Mass. & O. went Republican.
Wed. 9 Went to walk with Simon, twice. Classes. Letters from Wilder & Annie. Wrote to nobody today.
Thurs. 10 Wrote to Abby Morse & Kittie Eno. Letter from Pater. Meeting at 4 of teachers interested in a wedding present for Miss Freeman. No leader for praryermeeting. Rain.
Fri. 11 Wrote to Lizzie McCleery and Annie Reynolds. Drove to Wellesley Hills with Katherine in afternoon to call on Miss Gray and Helen Nor[[?]] saw the baby Katherine. Miss Freeman spoke to

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
the Academic Council about the exaggerated and alarming reports of College debt, circulated by the Alumnae. Miss Van Vleck called in the evening - went early to bed.
Sat. Classes as usual. Swept & dusted. Went over to Mrs. Durant's with Miss Jackson just before dinner. Mended stockings with Miss Jackson for a little after dinner.
Sun. 13 Set out to go to church in the village, but met Miss Cynthia Barber with her father, and brought them up to our room - they staid to dinner here and visited a little while after dinner. Cl[[?]] Bacheler was here over Sunday with Katherine. came to my room in P.M. Grace Duncan took supper with me & we went to meeting in the Village, with Grace Eastman also. I spoke to Mr. Hathaway. he led the Young People's Meeting. 
Mon. 14 Wrote to Uncle George. Misses Suddoth, Matthews, Anna Clara Smith, Mary C. Smith Knickerbocker, Liliian White, Minnie Spencer, Mrs McClintock, Gurney Griffeth. We went to ride with Grace Duncan, Grace Eastman & Jennie Wetherlow - to Echo Bridge. Simon & I called this evening on Misses Freeman, Dunlap, Jones, Miller, Mitchell, Gage, Gardner, Emerson, Mayse, Lyons, went to see Helen Homes before supper. Ethel spent the morning

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
at the dentist's in Newton. Miss Roberts sick today.
Tues. Classes. Went with Miss Cooley to call on Mr. Cowan. Wrote to John.
Wed. Studied Bible lesson on Tabernacle. Classes in P.M. Went to walk right after breakfast. Prayermeeting led by Miss Denis- Wrote to Wilder.
Thus. Classes. Went to walk after breakfast & after lunch. Wrote to Mrs. Millspaugh, & Grace Nathan.
Fri. Wrote to Miss C. A. Cary, Hattie Johnson, Mollie Marshall, Fanny Wood, Beatrice Gray, Laura McKean, Annie Reynolds - Postal fr. John - wrote to John.
Sat. Classes as usual - letter from Uncle Herbert & one from Miss Inez Matthews, each with some money for our Norumbega Fund. Bible Meeting (of 3) at 3:10. Fair at Norumbega for Monroe Fund this afternoon & evening. Went with Simon between 7 and 8. Letter from Mrs. Watson.
Sun. Awake most of the night with lame - rheumatic leg - staid in room all day. Unwell time too. Read Chronicles of Schonberg [?Cotta] Family. Dr. Speakman came to see me just before supper. Miss Emerson & Miss Mayse came in after dinner - Miss Freeman spoke

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
to the Freshmen at Stone Hall Parlor this evening.
Mon. 21 Letter from Pater & picture of Harl. Leg better this morning. Wrote to Uncle Herbert, Miss Matthews, Mrs. Watson - read some & slept some. Ethel went to dentist this morning -
Tues. 22 Lovely weather. Classes as usual - Went to Miss Townsend's in afternoon, & again after dinner, with Simon. Made list of books for Edith Wilkinson - corrected some papers. Kept office hours - wrote letter home. Postal from John - 
Wed. 23. Went to Boston at 7:54 with Miss Tuttle - came out at 11:05. John &Hall Nyce arrived on 2:16 train & walked up. We took them around the house - called very briefly in Christabel Lee - John, Ethel & I left at 4:28 for Millbury - in the rain - reached there about 6:30. had supper, went to prayermeeting, conversed. went to bed -
Thurs. 24 Thanksgiving Day - went to church - Mr. Hoyt, the Baptist man, preached - Luke 4:17.18.19. Walked down to Post Office with John in afternoon - Paul Thayer, Mr Waters & Caine Waters called in evening - Florence made some chocolate candy -
Fri. 25 Went to dressmaker's & did not find her - brought dress back again - went through Mr. Waters' mill very rapidly & partially, on way to 9:50 train -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
We all then came back to Wellesley - here at 11:07. Bible lesson at 2:20. Took John through the basement - catacombs. He staid until 9:20 - then went over to Bailey's Hotel for the night. Marne Wheeler's brother, Jogh was here too. Nellie Page's wedding cards came.
Sat. 26 John came over to chapel - went to Boston at 10 -to take 11 oclock express for New York - classes as usual - Went to South Natick in evening to talk a little Temperance to Saturday Nigh Club. Very foggy night.
Sun. 27 Foggy in morning - cleared about 11 - went to church & Sunday School in Village - to Stone Halle in afternoon to see about prayermeeting. Led prayers this evening. had the Chautauqua Sunday Service at Section prayermeeting this evening. Dr. Houry preached at College.
Mon. 28 Letter from Pater & Miss Howes & Ralph. Circular of Church Work fr. Mr. Cowan - went with Ethel to dentist in A.M. to dressmaker in Natick in P.M. Rev. Hugh Montgomery gave a Temperance Address here this evening, so  a small audience, alas. Wrote to Mrs Watson, Mrs Seymour, Uncle George - Life Insurance Circular came. 
Tues. Went to breakfast with Mr Montgomery & heard him talk until he left to take the

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
8:25 train - he talked about the special work they try to do in the cities, just now. Classes as usual. Written Reviews at 9:00 & 1:30. Did paper in evening.
Wed. Did one set of papers this morning. Went to walk also - cold - Prayermeeting on Temperance led by Mis Currier. 
Thurs. Dec. 1. Cold - Classes all day - went out doors after lunch. Phillips Brooks spoke at 7. He that overcometh shall inherit all things - immortality - personal friendship with God (white stone & new name). purity. (shall walk with me in white.) participate in God's purpose & work (pillar in the temple of my God.) power to aid right & rebuke wrong (to sit down with me on my throne.)
Fri. 2 Bible lesson on The Offerings. Hydrogen experiments in Laboratory this week. Mr Clapp lectured on Twelfth Night. very good - difference between a good (Sir Andrew & a donkey. (Malvolio) - praise of Viola +c -
Sat. 3 Swept & dusted room. Alumnae Meeting at 3. letters fr. Dora Freeman & Alma Wright - & Helen Sanborn. Read "Daughter of Fife" ^ mended stockings with Miss Jackson in evening - Class of '87 in force at Alumnae Meeting (Farsworth 7 Vant.)

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sunday Dec. 3 warmer & gray all day - Went to church in Village morning & evening - Dr. N.G. Clark preached at College - Ethel and I saw him after the evening service (Missionary Meeting. Miss Hodgkins on McAll Mission.)
Monday Went with Ethel to Newton to dentist. she had 3 teeth pulled. good gas & felt pretty well used up after it. came back on 11:50 train. Spent some time in afternoon & evening in conferring with the Alumnae -Concert by Miss Andres & Cal Fulten -
Tues. Dec. 5 Classes as usual. Faculty Meeting, Miss Freeman's last one. Alumnae Conference just before it.
Wed. 6 Went to Boston at 7:54 & returned at 11 - 2 classes in P.M. H experiments at 1:30. Meeting in evening to talk over Smith Concert - did not go to praymeeting - exam at 3:10
Thurs. 7 Classes all day. Went to walk after lunch - lovely springlike day. office hours for 3:10 class. Mr. Kuon, missionary form Japan, spoke this evening - Miss Kuon's brother.
Friday. 8 Sent letters to Pater, John, Mrs Seymour, Uncle George. Went to Natick to dressmaker after Bible class. Went to Meeting to arrange schedule of examinations, as our Head was not well tonight. Prof. Honsford read his paper on Lief Ericson at 7:30

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sat 9 Brushed & dusted room. fussed over Christmas presents - Geology. & 2:20 class. Gen'l Armstrong was here in P.M. with some of his students to speak & sing in chapel at 4. Simon & I went to see the Townsend's this evening. Katherine's books arrived. The College Beautiful - Began Simon's mittens - 
Sun. Dec. 10 Church +c. Prayermeeting led by Miss Court - Went to Y.P. Meeting in Village
Mon. 11 Ethel & I went to Boston - Grace Duncan with us. Christmas shopping - went at 7:54 & returned at 1:30 - Mr. Cable read here in the evening - Mrs Watson & Mr Safford came - Mrs Seymour came not.
Tues. 12 Classes as usual. Reception to Miss Freeman - informal - in evening. vase was presented.
Wed. Term closed at 12:30 - cracked some hickory nuts in P.M. Ethel must go to Boston to exchange her shoes. I went not to breakfast. did not do much all day.
Thurs. 15 Packed box to send home. and trunk for Millbury. took 2:16 train thither - in the rain - reached there 3:30 -
Fri. 16 Knit on Simon's mittens. Went to hear Whittier (80th birthday) exercise at High School in P.M. Young People's Meeting in evening.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sat. Wrote to Miss Eaton, Mrs Seymour, Edith, John, Nette, & note to Pater. Finished 1st mitten. Letter from home. Went for mail. Went to Christmas rehearsal in evening - Mr. Roberts, missionary at Kalgan, China, came. 
Sun. 18 Mr. Roberts spoke morning 7 Evening. We sang much in afternoon. Snow nearly all day - A.M. sermon. "And these from the land of [?Sinina]"
Mon. 19 Went to Worchester with Uncle Geo, Aunt Lou, horse & carriage - in afternoon - We made molasses candy in evening. Lovely weather.
Tues. Finished Simon's mittens. Called at Mrs Waters - went after mail - Rehearsal in evening.
Wed. Jennie arrived with her roommate BirdieTrott. Prayermeeting in evening.
Thurs. 22 Mended dress. Went coasting with Harry & Flora. Rehearsal in evening.
Fri. 23 Harry & I went after a Christmas Tree - Jennie, Birdie, Ethel & I went to Worcester in P.M. on cars. Young Peoples' Meeting -
Sat. 24 Wrote to Nette & Pater. tried to skate. Went sleighriding to West Millbury -
Sun. 25 Snow. Went to church morning & evening - Christmas service - good music. Uncle Geo. preached at West Millbury in afternoon. A.M. Sermon - The child Jesus - Luke 20: 40, 43, 51.52.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Mon. 26 Cloudy - Prepared for - and enjoyed Christmas Tree. Packages from Grace Duncan, Simon, Elizabeth Eliza - Turkey for dinner - had on tree cards, candy, and a pretty workbasket from May - 
Tues. Ethel & I went to Worcester 10:39. back at 4. took dinner at Mrs Jones - went to see Miss Eaton - Sleighride to prayermeeting at West Millbury in evening - Letter from Edith -
Wed. Wrote to John, Ralph, Simon, Cassius & E.E. & Grace Duncan. Preparatory Lecture - Snow. Rain. Clear Sky -
Thurs. Went through Mr Waters Mill - Letters from John, Pater, Nette, Mrs Seymour, Wrote to Mrs. S. cards to Pater, College - Miss Eaton.
Fri. 30 Finished silk mittens for Miss Eaton - young Peoples' meeting led by Paul Thayer - children made candy - Letter from Miss Eaton -
Sat. 31 Wrote to Miss Eaton, Marion Pelton guild, Nellie Page Bates, Dora Freeman - Left Millbury 9:50 A.M. stopped at Wellesley. 11:07 to 12:15. heard Cable in Boston - preached Winchester about 5 P.M.
Sun.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
1888.
Jan. 1 Winchester, Mass. Mr Seymour PS. 119:30
Rain - very slippery weather - went to church. S.S. & Communion Service in P.M. Stayed in in evening.
Jan. 2 Mon. Went with Mrs. S to Mrs Coits' in P.M. good time with children - read - Old & New Testaments +c
Tues. Studied - made some Bible questions. In P.M. went to Mrs Thompson's & to Library with Mrs. S. In evening to prayermeeting at Highlands, a mile away with Mrs. S. & MIss Pressy -
Wed. Left Winchester 8:38 - Boston, 10 reached W.C. about 11. Found box from home with much & various candy +c. Did Note Books diligently afternoon & evening. 
Thurs. 5 Frist day of term - 4 classes. experiments in all. Rush - Prayermeeting in evening. Letters fr. John, Annie, Miss Howard, Pater. Bible Meeting in evening.
Fri. 6 Wrote to Mrs Watson, John, Edith. went to see Mrs Manly & Miss Chandler - about Bible questions. Prayermeeting in village in evneing with Helen Baldwin. Had a beautiful box of candy yesterday from the Misses Townsend.
Sat. 7 Classes as usual. Took corduroy dress to Mrs

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Vinal to be lengthened - studied Geology. Read "Harper" part of evening to C.C.P. mended hose.
Sun. Rainy. Went to Mr Cowan church in village - Prof. J. W. Churchill of Andover preached at College. Section meeting then in evening - only 8 people came. a New Year's meeting -
Mon. Spent most of day on the lounge. went not to dinner nor supper. Reception in evening to Prof. and Mrs. Palmer - went for a time - Emily Wheeler & her father & mother were here - also Lilla D. Patterson & Mr. P. Letters fr. Jo. & Dora
Tues. Wrote to Jo Cass. Dora Freemean, Pater, Nette, Uncle George. Classes as usual. Review lessons in Chem. Last Quiz in Geology. Caius Cassius Peterkin arrived yesterday to stay all the week - we are planning a family party to celebrate his visit- Snow nearly all day -
Wed. Bright, clear. day. Wrote to Mrs Seymour walked to village with Simon in A.M. Prayermeeting in evening. Miss Shafer led - Letters from Katherine - wrote to Miss Eaton. Caius came to breakfast at our table.
Thurs. 12 Classes. A lady, Miss Platt, came out with Prof. Niles & I gave some time to her - Party in honor of C.C.P. here in #144. made candy therefor, beginning at 4 P.M. The party broke up in

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
season for us all to go to prayermeeting - Letters from John & Harl - wrote to Miss Howes & Carrie Post. Letter from Aunt Anna -
Friday Snowing in morning. thawing in afternoon. clear in evening. fine show of Aurora Borealis. Last Bible lesson of Semester today. Tried to take a nap. Helen Baldwin & I went to praymeeting in village, very slippery in places. Mr. Fisher spoke, making some personal statement. Miss Kendall went away this morning.
Sat. 14 Swept & dusted room. Last Geology Lecture. Ethel & I went down to Miss Townsend's to see Elizabeth Eliza. Mended clothes in evening & read Rescued from Egypt. 
Sun. 15 rain part of day. wet & slippery - Went to church & Young People's Meeting in village. Union prayermeeting. Freshman at Stone Hall. anna [Annack?] led. Very good.
Monday 16 Made Geology examination questions. Went to Mrs Vinal's in afternoon. to Miss Montague's Cleanup Party in evening. The Peirian Sodality of Harvard College gave a concert at W.D. this evening for benefit of the Tunis Association. 
Tues. 17 Went to Boston at 8:15 with C.C. & E.E. to buy a co[?n]y skin to wrap the baby bunting in - wh. we sent to Miss Sarah Van Pelt for

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Lillian's baby. back at 1:30 - Went to meeting at church to organize a W.C. T.U. Miss Tobey was there. Faculty meeting in evening.
Wed. 18 Geology examination in A.M. during wh. I wrote to Miss Van Pelt, Annie, Wilder in afternoon, we prayed with the A[??]ia freezer with no success. Prayermeeting, which I led, in evening.
Thurs. 19 Chemistry examination in A.M. My divisions B & C at Stone Hall. Wrote to Miss Eaton, Katherine & read Independent. Did some papers in P.M. Dr. Mackenzie spoke this evening.
Fri. 20 Did papers nearly all day. Went to village with Helen Baldwin in evening - Party at Stone Hall. Made questions for extra examination in Chemistry -
Sat. 21 Chem. examination - did Note Bks - made out certificates of examination - Ethel went to Symphony Concert in evening.
Sun. 22 Dr. Judson Smith preached, Bishop Paddock & Rev. Edward Abbot having successively failed. Moonlight prayermeeting here in #144 - only a few present for all my special invitation laboriously written and sent. A good visit with Dr. Smith after prayermeeting -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Mon 23 Led prayers, Miss Shafer sitting on platform meanwhile - Finished up Note Books & Cards - Went to M Marsh's house twice - Cold day. Lecture on Russian Literature by Ivan Pannin - Reception thereafter in Browning Room, thanks to Mdlle See - I went; so did C. C. P - Began on Geology papers

Tues 24 Finished Geology papers - Presided at 2nd W. C. T. U. meeting in village - went to see Mrs Manly afterward, then to dinner with Carrie Soule at Washington St. House - Made out cards & wrote notes in evening - Letter from Wi

Wed 25 Bible examination in A.M. Helped prepare for Chlorine Experiments in afternoon. Prayer meeting in evening, after which I went sleighriding with Carrie Soule's family. got in just before last bell. 

Thurs 26 Day of Prayer for Colleges. Dr. John Hall preached - text - 2 Cor 3:18. Class Prayer Meetings at 10 - did not go. Miss West of Constantinople & Su[?] Coffee House & c spoke in the parlor at 4 - very interesting - General Prayer Meeting in evening _ Dr Hall left

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
almost immediately after church-
Fri. 27. Regular work began again, Cl
experiments at 9. For 2 divisions. all
very successful. Mr. Cable taught us
the International S.S. lesson at 3:10 just
as he teaches it in Boston. 3:10 classes
met at 2:20 today, including our Freshman
Bible teachers meeting- Helen Baldwin +
I went to prayermeeting in the Village. Miss
Morgan spoke, also Miss Julia Eastman-
Sat. 29 Lel experiments at 4:00, for 10:55
and 1:30 classes. the oil of turpentine did
not blaze, but the Cu did.
Our table went sleighriding in the evening and
had hot lemonade + crackers in my room
afterward. Met at 7 + returned at 8:30.
Total eclipse of the moon this evening.
Sun. 29 Bright, cold weather. Went to church
+ S.S. in the Village. Taught Mrs. Burrell's
class. Prayermeeting in the Durflinger's
room at Stone Hall. 13 girls of the section
there. Miss Fanning + Fellows. Prof. Ladd of
New Haven preached at College today. text- "I
lay down my life that I might take it again."
Mon. 30 Prof. + Mrs Hill's Reception this evening. I
went with Carrie Soule. Met Mr. Dunham-
had rather a good time.  was the only represent-

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
-ation of the Chem. Dept. there.  Mended clothes & finished bible papers & cards in daytime.
Went to Village - returned Mrs. Currier's horses(?)

Tues. Classes as usual - very tired - went to bed at 7:30
Wed. Went to Christian Endeavor Meeting in village in evening with Nisba Breckinridge & Hattie Farnsworth.
Thurs. Pres. Joseph Ward spoke in the evening on  "The more excellent way - Love" Did experiments at 9 & 3:10 - I had another class at 9 so did not participate - but was much choked at 3:10.
Friday Misses Rehester, Raul, &Patteson came from Cambridge- Harvard ???? to spend the day here and attend classes - friends of Miss Eaton's- We entertained them to the best of our ability.

Sat. Feb 4 Classes.  Lecture in evening on total eclipses of the sun. by Prof. C.A. Young of Princeton.  Fire at Stone Hall from a lamp set on a mantel bed, wh, was then opened.  Ethel swept the room in P.M. Snow. Sunday thaw. deep slush & water.

Feb. 5 Went to church & Sunday School in village.  Rev. Mr. Durant of Baltimore preached at College Communion Service.  Mrs. Capron(??)

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
#155. Letters from Pater - & Prof. Starr. Wrote valentines -
Tues. 14 Warm. thawing. Fountain experiment & etching at 9 & 10:55 - the fountain exploded at 10:55. 1:30 class finished Br & S. Simon & I went over to Freeman Cottage in P.M. but could not get in - Saw Miss Arnold & M.E.B. - about Freshman prayermeeting. Wrote to John & to Harl. Celebration at table - Valentines - & the children surprised us with icecream, cake, fruit, flowers - pretty dishes & white dresses - we had a fine time all round - Early to bed - Books came from J.B. Allen.
Cold again - windy & slippery - mended clothes, studied Bible lesson. Wrote to Mrs. Seymour, & to Mr. H.H. Johnson at Harvard. Letter from Miss Van Pelt, with first picture of Lillian's boy. Went to evening with Helen Baldwin & Ethel to entertainment at chapel of village church - Miss Knox and Miss Tuttle were there also -
Thus. Classes continually, almost - Wrote letter home - studied Bible lesson a little - Prayermeeting in evening - Miss M.E.B. Roberts led -
Fri. 7 Classes. Began on Note Books - went to Village in evening with Helen Baldwin - Made plans of Gymnasium for Smith Concert. Letter from Mr. Johnson. 7 young med coming Tuesday evening.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sat. 18 - Warm weather. Note Books much. Helped sell tickets for Smith Concert - Letter fr. Mrs. Watson. Mr Safford is coming - Letter from Mrs Seymour, she cometh not. Walked to village in P.M. Note Books in evening - House of Commons Debate on House Rule in Gymnasium. Letter from little Margaret Seymour. also one from Jo Case - Cider leaflets from Mrs Edwin Fuller for Dana Hall. 
Sun. 19 Beautiful weather - colder. Simon away - went to church in Village - Vesper Service here after chapel - Miss Sleeper being here for Sunday. Freshman Class prayermeeting at Stone Hall, led by Miss M.R.B. Roberts - Prof. Doolittle of New Brunswick, preached at College - text, Mar. 9:35
Mon. 20. Went to Boston at 7:54 with Ethel to dentist - Dr. Allen; 13 Arlington St. He pulled out her tooth & we came out at 10. Did Note Books in P.M. Celebration of Mr Durant's birthday in evening. Mr. Breckenridge gave the address - there was a reception to him afterwards. 
Tues. Classes as usual - Worked in gymnasium in P.M. helping to arrange boxes for the evening - In evening, came the Smith Concert & 8 young men. Misses Safford, Johnson, Kimball, Howland, Chapman, Cowles

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Mead, Graham, The ladies provided were Misses Soule, Florence Soule, Aurnack, Jones, Morgan, Dunlap, Metcalf & Metcalf - I think all had a good time - Mr Mead stayed till late train.
Wed. 22 Went at 10 with M. Marsh to Cambridge via Newton - called on Mrs Palmer with Miss Lord, Misses Duncan, Blord, Cushman & Weatherlow. Then went to Boston, Called on Marion Pelton Guild - Then to Perkins Institute for the Blind, where we saw Laura Bridgeman & much beside -
Thurs. Classes - Note Books +c - Letter from Mr Johnson, enclosing 7 dollars which much troubled me - Business meeting of Christian Association in evening -
Fri. Written Reviews at 9 & 10:55. Bala[?] at 2:20. W.C.T.U. meeting in village at 3:30 - Wrote to Mrs Seymour, Prof Staff, Mr. H.M. Reynolds, Mr. Brown, of C.M. & St. P. Ry. Mary Beattie. Letter fr. Mary Beattie. Letter about the N.E.A. meeting in San Francisco - Went to see Miss Shafer -
Sat. Corrected examination papers. 2 sets - class at 2:20. Snow turning to rain. Presided at guest table at dinner - more documents from C.M. & St. P. Ry

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Wrote to Jo Cass. Alumnae Meeting at 3 in Browning Room - no one here from outside Bates, Pendleton, Roberts, Marsh, Soule, Aumack, Burlingame, Barrows, Rice - 
Sun. 26 Went to church in village in A.M. Rev. Mr. DeForest, of Tauton, preached at College - Simon & I went after pussy willows in P.M. Prayermeeting, led by Grace Duncan, in her room - "Thy kingdom come." Very wet walking.
Mon. 27 Finished Note Books - mended clothes. wrote letter home - went to village & to take the "Cider Series" to Miss Eastman in P.M. to Mrs Livermore's lecture, "A Dream of Tomorrow" in evening - Pupil's Concert at College - Made problems -
Tues. 28 Letter from John - Classes as usual - Faculty Meeting in evening.
Wed. 29 Wrote to John - Made examination questions - Ex. at 1:30 - class at 3:10. Walked down towards Dana Hall with Virginia Smith - Prayermeeting led by Miss Tuttle - 
Thurs. Mar. 1 Oxygen experiments at 9 - 10:30, and 1:30 - Examination at 3:10 - Prayermeeting in evening - Miss Barrows led -
Friday. 2 Chemistry & Bible classes - Examination papers & Note Books - Bible Meeting at 3:10 - walked down to Mrs Townsend's with Mrs Manly thereafter. 
Sat. 3 Did examination papers - 3:10 class - Swept

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
and dusted room. Went to village to mail flowers to Miss Eaton - Marion Marsh went to Andover and came back again. Clara Emerson came in between 6 and 7. Alumnae Reunion with Mr and Mrs North in Browning Room at 8. Received appointment as President of Fire Committee in this building. Ellen Burrell, Vice Pres. - mended stockings. Ethel had a letter from Annie - Rev. C.W. Shelton spoke at 4 on The Indians - especially The Dakotas -
Sun. 4 Did not go to meals - rose from bed about 12:30 P.M. - read Independent +c - all the table girls except Misses Freeman, Miller and Mitchell, came to see me. Mr. North preached - "Our conversation is in heavan" - Missionary Meeting this evening. Dr. E.E. Strong, Editor of Missionary Herald, spoke on Africa - 
Read "The man with the Book-" a story of City Missionary work in London -
Mon. 5, Notebooks. mending. Wrote letter to Gertrude Chandler - Lecture by Prof. Rolfe on "Tempest" in evening - Read Tempest in afternoon -
Tues. 6 Classes - Faculty Meeting in evening - interviewed people in afternoon - Letter fr. Home -
Wed. 7 Praymeeting led by M.E.B. Roberts - Inter-

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
[at very top of page - Wrote to Jo Class - ]

viewed many people - went to walk in A.M. Ozone at 1:30. sent Reception invitation to Mr. Johnson, Mr Mead & Mr Chapman - Wrote to Mary Lewis' mother. letter from Wilder -
Thurs. Began letter to [?] before breakfast - Fireworks at 1:30 - Ozone at 3:10 - Simon & I went to the tinshop just before dinner - Miss Knox led prayermeeting. Cold, rather. Letter & Yale Catalogue form Mr. Reynolds - 
Friday. Classes as usual - W.C.T.U. - meeting at 3:30 Miss Gordon, Sec. of Mass Union, spoke - very interesting - Sent letter to Wilder -
Sat. Swept & dusted rooms - Went after ice & experiments therewith with Prof. Horsford - Ellen Burrell & I had some Committee meeting in evening. sold tickets form Fair for House for Intemperate Women - Prof Niles here on Friday -
Sun. Went to church & S.S. in village. Mr. Pease of Malden preached at College - Prayermeeting in #111. Miss Carter led - & Miss Newell played for us -
Mon. Ethel & I went to Boston at 8:15 - Terrible storm, snow & wind. bought Jersey - Went to Evangelical Alliance, & to hear Miss Willand's Prelude on "Women's Ballot as a Temperance Measure," at Joseph Cook's lecture - came out at 3:45. dreadful weather - Very few people came to the

title: Marion Metcalf diary [05], 1883-1889
transcription:
Concert. some who did come waited at the station till 4 A.M. for the 9:38 train back to Boston. Concert for Students' Aid Society - Beethoven Soc. King Reve's Daughter -
Tues. Taught classes at 9 & 10:55. C.F.R. taught my 1:30 class. Went on 1:53 train to Cambridge to Mrs. Palmer's to meet Miss Willard, with Temperance Com. & Nisba Breckenridge - Had a fine time - back on 6:35 train - Lemon Ice in evening -
Wed. Went to village in A.M. after maple sugar or syrup - unsuccessful - Mrs. Nary had some, however, and we had a very good time in the evening  - with sugar on snow in Lab. with our table, everyone present & happy - each brought a spoon.
Thurs. Classes as usual. No letters yet. Miss L.F. Clark did prayermeeting - 
Fri. Geography day in Bible class - Lottie Roberts and I went to Boston at 5 - to Fair for Home for Intemperate Women - back on 9 oclock train - I walked to station with Miss Calkins - We did not go to the Idler Club in Cambridge - letter from Miss Frances Willard - also one from Prof. Starr -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
193

…the night. Miss Emerson & I went with Miss Gilbert to the Missionary Reception—met Mr. & Mrs. Lewis, Mr. & Mrs. Corbett, Mr. Shaw.

Tues. 3
Assembly opened in evening—speeches. Went in A.M. with Aunt Albina to find place & help settle in it. Tramped around with Nettie in P.M. Went to Amphitheatre in evening of course.

Wed. 4
Children’s Class with Nettie at 8. No Advanced Normal at 9. German—Nettie. Had Miss Willard in P.M. Shakespeare Class. Rev. Readings by Buckley and Congress Proceedings in evening. Spoke to Rev. Mr. Burnell of Seattle. Washed. Letter to Pato.

Thurs. 5
Mr. Dunning’s Class & German. Rain—Hour of Mrs. Bokast. Hour of German. Hour of Shakespeare Class in P.M. Rev after supper, then Mr. Dunning’s Lecture & studied German a little. Wrote letter home. Nettie had a letter.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Fri. 6
Cleared off, warm & pleasant.
Maud’s Class & German in A.M.
German & Macbeth in P.M.
Decided to have Nettie come here on Monday. Mrs. Jones arrived this morning & nobody there to meet her.
Did not go to supper, nor out at all in the evening—Nettie came over & read to me.
Letters from home.

Sat. 7
Went to Normal Class at 9. Spent remainder of A.M. mostly on bed. Nettie & I went by steamer to Lakewood & back in P.M.

Sun. 8
Mr. Gifford preached a good sermon—"God is a Spirit & they that worship Him must worship Him in spirit & in truth."
S.S. R.S. House—Did not go out in evening. Mr. Wilk of Louisville, Ky. preached. Warm, very—also lake flies many.

Mon. 9
Classes as usual. Mrs. Bullock & Mr. Lieber arrived in P.M. Nettie over here after dinner.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Tues. 10
Classes. Went over to see Mrs. Buflockte. Nettie & I went to Cong. Sociable in evening -saw Mr. Dunning, Nichols, Davidson[?]
Wed. 11
Classes-Rowing
Thurs. 12
Fri. 13
Sat. 14 Cable read in AM the story of Grande Pointe. arrived late, read until after 1 & no one wanted him to stop. Rock Band Concert in P.M.
Sun. 15 Dr. Vincent preached. Cable conducted assembly S.S. Dr. Goodsell of New Haven in evening. went to neat collage to sing, in evening.
Mon. 16 Cable read again. Posson Jane & several selections from Dr. Sevier. Annie Bushwell came.
Tues. 17 Advanced Normal Examination in A.M. through soon after 10. but did not go late to German. Prof. Schmitz made his farewell and left to see his wife and his new baby - Congregational Sociable. 
Wed. 18. C.L.S.C. Recognition Day. We went out to see the procession, wherein Miss Ementon

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
marched. Miserable headache.
Thurs 19 Preparations for going home. Trunks went this evening. Went rowing for 1/2 hour with Nettie, Miss Soddoch & Lloy.
Fri. 20 Took 6:30 A.M. boat to Mayville, Therese home. Mrs. Jones & Annie with us as far as Clevelend. Home about noon in time to eat dinner with the family. Went to Salvation Army in evening Harl, Ethel, Harry, Nettie, Grace, Johnson. Julia West & I.
Sat. 21 Annie & Mr. Root came home at noon.To church Sunday. Ethel went home with Grace Johnson to spend Sunday.
Sun. 22 Annie arranged the flowers in church - asters, marigolds, etc. Prof. Foster preached on the divinity of Christ. Went to Young People's meeting, but no evening services. Annie Rick led Y.P.M.
Mon. 23 Ethel came back tonight. Ripped & cleaned my old black silk skirt. Edith came over. 
Tues. 24 Went to Library - worked on black silk - wrote to Mr. McCoy, Miss Eaton, Miss Fuller, Miss Marsh.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Wed. 25 Called on Salvation Army captain & Cadet. Ethel, Harl & I went to Aunt Mollie's to tea. Annie & Harry came over for a little while in the evening. Mrs. Jones was there - came yesterday.
Thurs. 26 Pressed green dress & black silk. Prayer meeting led by Mr. Ely. Uncle Herbert & Aung Jennie here all day.
Fri. 27 Went with Annie Rick to Lake to see the Shaufflers - started about 1:30 - very hot - stopped to see Lou Day. Went in bathing & met most of the family in the water. Were persuaded to stay all night. A fine "sing" in the evening. Prof. & Mrs. Chamberlain, Mr. & Mrs. Drane & the Schaufflers.
St. 28 Started for home about 9:30. Very hot again. Reached house just before a heavy rain. Went over to Aunt Mollie's in P.M. to see Lucy, Ede & Flo etc. Went also to Library. Flowers for church in P.M. - then Salvation Army meeting. in margin: Letter from Miss Fuller.
Sun. 29 Mr. Williams preached in A.M. Keep yourselves in the love of God  S.S. Read with children in afternoon - very heavy

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
rain about 5:30. Went to Y.P. Meeting - no leader. Home. supper - bed - rain again in the evening.
Mon. 30 Rain - rain-
Tues. 31 Went to Aunt Anna's to supper. Came home & played games in evening.
Wed. Sept. 1 Clear & cool. Went with Annie to Uncle Charlie's to supper. Packed.
Thurs. 2 Went to Oberlin with Annie at 8 A.M. to see Ethel's room - Library & Prof. Jewette's dor[[?]]ous - had a good time & learned something - Packed in P.M. Went to see Flo & her baby. Prayer with - [[?]] - Mrs. Smith (Kate M.) Walked home with Harl & me -
Fri. 3 Packed etc in A.M. - took 1:36 train for W.C. met Miss Chandler at Cleveland & took section with her. saw Annie Bushwell there also.
Sat. 4 Worcester at 1:18 - went home to dinner with MIss. Eaton & felt much better for it. [Wile?] at 5:05.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Jack reached home from his su[[?]]uer's work in Kansas. 
No trunks till Monday. Early to bed.
Sunday Sept. 5 Church & S.S. r. Couran preached on the prophesies of Christ in O.T. Went home with the Townsend's for rest of day - went to Mrs. Lorrwell's in P.M. to call on Mrs. Safford & Mrs. Watson, from Dumbarton, N.H. Missionary meeting in evening.
Mon. 6 Unpacked trunks & box - hung pictures, conferred with Miss Freeman. Wrote home to Miss Fuller, went after water lilies - Letters from Pater & Cassius [[?]] Normal Union Diploma, box of pears from Mr. Couran - note from Miss Eaton.
Tues. 7 Went through certificates of the 160 Freshmen to see about their Gerg. examinations. Went to meeting of Board of Examiners, Made list - etc - tired - M. Marsh not well.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Wed. 8 Went to Dana Hall to borrow a [[?]] Phys-Geog. Made examination questions in Mod. & Phys-Geog. Interviewed girls nearly all day - called on Mrs. Cornan, who was not at home - went to meeting of Board of Examiners - wrote to Miss Eaton & to Cassius [[?]] - Miss Fuller arrived - Prof. Niles came to see me -
Thurs. 9 Worked on schedule till 10. Then interviewed girls nearly all day - Meeting of Board of Examiners from 6:30 - 8:00. Term opened - many students - little peace. Very warm a little rain in P.M.
Fri. 10 More office hours interviewing girls. Another Meeting of Heads. some labor in trying to rearrange Qual. Anal. hours
Sat. 11 Geography Examinations. Office hours. Labor over geology schedules consultation over a possible de' [[?]]artuent Bibleclass - Late but pleasant interview with Miss

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Freeman. Wherein I asked her an innocent question.
Sunday Sept. 12 Flower Sunday - a bright day - some rain in evening Prayer meeting at 11 led by MIss Shafer, Pres. of  Christian Association - Service at 3:30. sermon on "God is Love" by Rev. P.S. Mo[[?]]. I met him afterwards and had a nice little talk with Miss Hallowell. Miss Cooley. Miss Howes, Ellen Burrill came to see me. Class prayer meetings in evening. Kari Gawkle's father led evening prayers loud and clear. 
Monday Sep. 13 Schedules and Geography examination with notifications of results thereof. Meeting of Heads at 4. A gentleman from Tarsus talked in the parlor this evening. Wrote to Prof. Niles and to the home people.
Tues. 14 Beautiful day. Classes begin. Mr. William Hayes came up to go through

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
our laboratories. taught class at 1:30. Geology Lecture at 10:55. Head Meeting in the evening. Went to walk with the whole department. Tried to arrange geology schedules.
Wed. 15 Classes - Quant. at 11:45. Geom Chem at 1:30. Went rowing. Studied schedule. Faculty Meeting in evening. Began a letter to Miss Eaton.
Thurs 16 Classes - Geol. Lecture. Letter from home. Enclosing a pair of black kid gloves. Prayer meeting led by Miss Hodgkins. Rainy day.
Fri. 17 Sent letter to Miss Eaton, also a letter home. Quant. class at 1:30 - Toiled over schedules to equalize & arrange chemistry divisions - went after [?fringed gentians] in the afternoon. whole department. written in margin: Rain in evening - warm.
Sept. 18 First geology quiz. Went to walk - dusted room - tried to study geology - wrote to Prof. Jewete - Talked with Mr. Crawford about H20 machine orders chemistries & geologies -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sun. 19 Cool - rain in P.M. Went to chuch in Village with Miss Howe. Mr. Cowan preached to children on how to hear a services.
Rev. Edward Judson spoke here in P.M. on "The love of Christ contained with us." The motion power Christ's love for us - Its operations - upholding - pushing us - giving a healthful compressing - very little in the Bible about our love to God - 
Mon. 20 Clear. cool. Tested Miss Stratton's tapestry & found no arsenic therein. Studied some - called on the Baldwins & went to see Fraulein Hintermeister and her stories. Two receptions this evening - Sophomores to Faculty & Freshmen. Specials to Faculty & new specials -
Letter from Miss Jennie.
Tues. 21 An eventful day. Made a mistake & rose at 5:30 instead of 6:30 - wrote 2 letters before breakfast, one

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
to Uncle George and one to Jack. My new Chem division met for the first time. After coming from it, I found a letter from Prof Niles, saying it was doubtful whether he will be able to come to lecture Friday. He came not, & I some quizzed & some talked to the class myself. I was rather terrified & excited thereby - class at 1:30 - M. Marsh & I went to call on Mr. Durant - to talk of H2O machines, bookracks, Mr. Durant's picture & other subjects. Had quite a successful time - Miss Fuller & Miss Kelsey joined us over in the leaky Pinta.
Wed. 22 Cool & clear. Classes as usual - made ready to put names on laboratory places - went after dinner to see the carpenter Mr. Johnstone about our blackboard. Prayer meeting led by Miss Chapin - wrote to Prof. Niles & to the home people - Letter from Prof Niles & one from Pater. Read article on Earthquakes in Popular Science Monthly.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Thurs. 23. Rain all day - Prof Niles came not.
2 letters from him - & I wrote 2 letters to him - discussed Geology Class.
Letter from Miss Eatori, enclosing one from Lottie, written from Grassmere.
Wrote to Miss Eaton - taught classes.
Went down to Miss Townsend, in rain with Miss Fuller. Marked Missionary envelopes - Had Meeting in evening - 
Prayer meeting led by Miss Whiting - 
“Place of Song in Worship” —

Friday. 24. Clear, beautiful day. Letters from Prof. Jewett, Prof. Niles & Pater. Jack is sick, with a sort of slow fever. Pater still shingly & the three infants have chicken pox.
Mary winks[[?]] & daughters & a few Odd Fellows, fr. the National Convention in Boston, were here this P. M. I assisted in showing some of them around. Read some in Nature & Pop. Sci. Monthly - growled & grumbled some.

Sat. 25. Taught Gelo. Class something about Earthquakes, as Prof Nicole’s came not -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Letter from Edith from Boston. Swept & dusted room. Went to R.R. station with Simon, Miss Kelsey & I. Read one of Bret Harte's stories aloud in evening.
Sunday 26 Went to bed after breakfast & spent the day there. Catherine, Carrie Soule, Miss Fiske, Knowlton, Slater, Stewart came to see me, Marion Marsh read to us me in P.M. Dr. Pierce preached.
Monday 17 Letter for Miss Eaton. Postal fr. Intercollegiate Alumnae Ass - wrote to Prof. Niles & to home people - on bed much of day - had intended to go to Boston -
Tues. 28 Rainy & gray all day. Letter from Prof. Niles. Wrote to Prof Niles - excused geology class.
Wed. 29 Beautiful clear weather once more. Worked on Record Book. Went to carpenter's for beanboard with Miss Kelsy. Classes as usual.
Thurs. 30 Another fine day. Cool. Prof Niles came and lectured - coughed some - Finished (nearly) work on Record Book. Played our new

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
beanbag game. Went after beans. Letter from Pater - also from Ethel - Bible Reading this evening, led by MIss Emerson.
Fri. 31 Edith arrived at 10:30. Went to station to meet her. carried chair to cobbler to have a leg taken out & he game me 3 porter apples to pay for it. We 80's went with Edith to dinner at the guest table. Letter from Mrs. Watson in Chelsea. I left with Edith in the Minister's Room.
Sat. Oct. 2 Prof Niles lectured at 10:55, so no quiz - went with Edith to dinner at Waban Cottage - then to call on Miss Horton - visited Marion Marsh's class at 3:10 & for a little at 9.
Sunday Oct. 3 Took breakfast at my own table, Edith being at Stone Hall with Katherine - dinner at S.H. at Miss Hallowell's table. supper at Switson Cottage - Dr. Breed of Philadelphia preached - Communion Service - Rev. Arthur Smith of North China spoke in the evening.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Monday Oct 4 Went to Boston at 10, and to the Aztec Fair with Elizabeth. Eliza bought books etc. in P.M. Came outside at 3:45. Anniversary Service for Mr. Durant this evening. Address by Dr. Duryea. Edith left at 11:44 A.M. for Worcester. Letter from Annie also from Soloman John - wrote home.
Tues. 5 Classes as usual - Prof. Niles came - Head Meeting 6:15-9:30.
Wed. 6 Went to Boston at 8 - came back at 10 - bought a rider for Balance etc - Prayer meeting in evening.
Thurs. 7 Christian Union came, also Independent - Letter fr. Mrs. Watson - sent letter to Miss Munger - Examination at 1:30 - Papers in evening - good [note good is underlined] - Christian Association Meeting.
Friday 8 Began work in Volumetrics Analysis with Quantitative Class. Chem examination at 9. Did papers in evening. Miss Kelseyand I went to prayer meeting in the village.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sat. 9 Lovely autumn weather - quite warm. Mr. Safford and Mrs. Watson came out in afternoon & took Miss Ridman and me to ride. From 2:30 to 5:30 - over to the Hills in West Dedham, back through Dedham and Needham - a delightful afternoon. Swept & dusted room. Mended stocking in Miss Howe's room in evening - Looked over some new Chem Library books.
Sun. 10 Another lovely day. Very warm. Episcopal Service here. Went to church & S.S. in village. Rev. Geo. Reid preached. Miss Howes and I went to Young Peoples' Meeting in evening. Read & studied the Bible in afternoon. Florence Marsh & Marion Benett came up.
Mon. 11 Fine weather still warm & dusty. The Faculty went to Norumbega, on Prof Honford's invitation. Tramped around there - ate lunch - dinner over to his home in Cambridge, stopping on the way to see the

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
view from Prospect Hill in Waltham. reached college on our return at 7 o'clock. a most delightful day -organ recital by Prof Whiting in evening to which I went not. Wrote to home people and to Harry. Letter from Cassius came.
Tues. 12 Very warm. clouds & rain at night. Classes as usual. Read Harvard Chemistry Experiments from Miss Eaton - was not able to get outdoor at all. so many interruptions in afteroon - office hours consultation with Miss Hurll etc. - Head Meeting 6:30 - 9:30 - note from Mrs. Cowan.
Wed. 13 Labor abundant - sent note to Mrs. Cowan in afternoon mail - went to walk alone - Prayer meeting led by Miss Emerson -
Thus. 14 Mr. Marsh & I went in evening to Sociable at Chapel in Village - I read Mrs. Purdy's [Parquisites?] thereat. Prof. Niles took geology class on short walk at 1 o'clock - I could not go, having class to teach - Letter from Ethel -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Fri. 15 Letter from Pater & Independent - Pray meeting in Village in evening withSimon - Harvest Moon -
Sat. 16 Cold & clear. Brushed & dusted room - called on Miss Cameron in P.M. Finished Note Books. Read a little German - Schouberg Cotta Family, in evening.
Sun. 17 Cold & clear. Went to church in Village. Mr. Waldron preached on the work of the Boston City Missionary Society. Dr. Harry preached at the College - Mrs. Smith of China, spoke in the evening.
Mon. 18 Cloudy in morning - ate breakfast in Bread Room & took 7:15 train to Boston. Left Boston by train at 10 A.M. walked over from {?Lynn to Nahaut]- a glorious walk & a good day - walked back, as bargeman refused to carry us - supper at Casius - took 6:30 train out. Mr. Leland Powers read from David Copperfield at College this evening. i went not. Wrote letter home. Card for Lottie - letter from Edith.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Tues. Wrote to Cassius Carus - Took a nap instead of a walk - General Faculty meeting in evening - no Head meeting.
Wed. 20 Wrote to Miss Eaton - letter from Abby Morse about a Botany of Edith's wh. she sent. Pray meeting in evening.
Thurs. 21 80's went to call on Helen Wo[[?]]ley Norcross. all except Carrie Soule & rue. I went to bed after teaching my 1:30 class. Read King Arthur by MIss Mubet.
Fri. 22. Did not go to breakfast, but taught my classes - went not to dinner either - Read The Hillyars & the Burtons by Henry Kingsley - corrected problems.
Sat. 23 Geol. quiz as usual - Simon & I went chestnutting to Wellesley Hills in P.M. - brought back some good apples & a few chestnuts - went to No. 102 with mending in evening.
Sun. 24 Church. S.S> 5 o'clock meeting - & the 2 services in Village in evening - Bible Study after dinner - Rebuked table for talking about people -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Mon. 25 Went to Newton with some of geol class to meet Prof Niles & see glacial scratches etc - then went tramping in Auburndale etc with him & two of his Tech. students - had a fine time - back at 2:16. Wrote to Pater, Prof. Jewett - & the Sec'y of Lowell [[?]]ust - courses - wrote invitations to Halloween party - letter from Uncle George - 
Tues. 26 Gray, rainy day - Did not go outdoors. Head meeting 7:30 - 10 and [[?]]. Prof. Niles gave me some [[?]]susies.
Wed. 27 Letter from Miss Eaton. Hunted for quotations for Halloween Party - Prof Horsford came out with Mr. Frank Cushing and three Zuni Indians, the governor of the tribe and 2 priests. We saw & heard them in chapel from 12:15 to 1:20 or so - I had the honor of shaking hands with them all at Chem. Lect. Room in afternoon - Prof Horsford put [[?Kou]] H2O to amuse the Zunis.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Thurs 28 Rain. Went to village with Simon to [[?plumber's]] for some [[solder]]. to Miss Townsend's to beg some apples. Annual Meeting of Christian Association this evening. Wrote letter to Ethel.
Fri. 29 Rain, rain. Wrote to Harry - brief letters to pater, Uncle George, & Abby Morse. Miss Freeman gone to Philadelphia and Bryn Mawr. Letter from Pater. 2 brief notes from Miss. Eaton.
Sat. Oct. 30 Rain. Rain. Walked to Natick & back in P.M. to buy chestnuts & ribbon, for our Halloween Party, wh. came off from 7:30 - 8:30 in Chem. Lect. Room, Many were in costume at dinner - a Statue of Liberty was unveiled & presented. 
Sun. 31 Rain. rain - quite tired & sleepy - coughing some. Mr. Peloubet preached - went to church - & 5 o'clock prayer meeting here - Bible Class in evening - with Misses Marsh, Kelsey & Howes.
Mon. Nov. 1 Cloudy in A.M. Cleared about noon - Went to Boston at 8:15 - did shopping - Noon Prayer meeting at Beacon Hill Church - dinner at Alhambra - then took streetcar for Cambridge to see Miss Eaton

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Reached Wellesley at 6:35. ate a supper of crackers & lemonade. Letter from Pater -
Tues. 2 - Fine weather - Classes as usual - Faculty Meeting in evening 6:30 to 9:45.
Wed. 3 Fine weather. warm. Tickets to Lowell Institute Lectures arrived - wrote to Annie - Began to study up- Soap for Quantitative work. Had an Interview with Miss Freeman - went to Prayer Meeting -
Thurs. 4 Went to walk to peat swamp with Prof Niles & Geology class - Trustee Meeting today - Bible Reading led by Miss Aurnack, this evening - subj. - "How to Study the Bible"-
Friday 5 "Lecture" on soap to Quant. class - Simon and * went to prayer meeting in the Village - Head Meeting at 4:45 to consider the case of Miss Cain - voted that she be obliged to leave college -
Sat. 6 Faculty Meeting after chapel to consider case of Miss Caine - Mrs. Shay swept

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
my room. Miss Guernsey was here in P.M. with two friends - took them around building etc. - Saw also Jennie Grant, Mary Jenckes Cook, Mary Welch - Rain - Rain - Read Little Lord Fauntleroy to table after silent time. Went later to Miss Shafer's room to a little party for Miss Foster -
Sun. 7 Communion Sunday in Village - Mr. Cowan preached on the marriage supper of the lab. Prof Tucker of Audorn, preached at College today - Missionary Meeting in evening. Home talent. Table came up in afternoon to hear Little Lord Fauntleroy. Miss Tuttle, Marsh, Kelsey & I had quite a confabulation after missionary meeting - Windy - clear - cold weather.
Mon. 8 Made examination questions. Went to see Miss Stratton & Miss Clark about domestic work. Letter from Pater & the muther about sending Ethel here after Christmas. Uncle Herbert & Aunt Jennie appear about 3 oclock. I

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Took them about this building & Stowe Hall - went to see Miss Edith Brooks. They left before supper. Faculty (Heads) meeting from 5 to 7. after wh. we Heads (!) had some supper together. Concert by Mr. Perry, pianist.
Tues. 9 Chem examinations at 9, 10:53 and 1:30 - Papers in evening - after Faculty meeting
Wed. 10 Announcement in chapel of the matter of Miss Cain, Miss Winston etc. More examination papers - Prayer meeting - Saw Miss Freeman about Ethel - wrote letter home on subject - Letter from Jack -
Thurs. 11 Rev. A.D. May, talked in the chapel at 7 - on education in the South - More papers & Problems & interviewing - Letter from Harl - wrote to Jack & sent mittens -
Friday 12 Another lesson on Soap - Simon & I went over to the paint mill & found that we could not visit it without a permit from the proprietors - I wrote to them -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
We did not have a Bible study at 2:20, but read Little Lord Fauntleroy in the evening -
Sat. 13 Rain & snow considerable - snow for the first of the season. Letter from Ethel - Looked over Cooley & First Lessons in Chemistry -
Sunday Nov. 14 Snow lasted in some places all day - cold & clear - Church in Village - Mr. Cowan preached on confessing sin - Bible Study in evening - Began to prepare for my Bible Reading Meeting - Read Christian Union & Independent -
Monday Nov. 15 Cold, bright day - went to Boston at 8:14 - back at 11. Took cloak to be repaired. Letters from Lottie Roberts - Geo. W. Cable [[?]] Grande Point here this evening & sang some Creole songs thereafter - Mrs. Watson & Mr. Safford came out to hear him
Tues 16 On the bed nearly all day - after 9 o'clock class. Read Shiloh.
Wed. 17 Taught class at 1:30 - on bed most of day - read a Second Life, by Mrs. Alexander.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Thurs. 18 Classes as usual - wrote letter home - prayer meeting led by Miss Roberts -
Fri. 19. Wrote to Henry Wood's Son & Co. to Pensy Richards - Miss Fuller. Mary Beattie & I went to Miss Townsend's to tea - had a good time. Marion Marsh in bed. I taught 10:55 Chem class & Carrie Soule's Bible Class.
Sat. 20 Letter from Harl. Wrote to Mrs. Watson & to Miss Colemen, who is fixing my winter cloak. Taught 9:00 chem. class. also Geology - Simon & I went down to Miss Townsend's in P.M. Table came up to read in evening  - Read "Through the Looking Glass." Miss Cameron called.
Mon. 22 Letters from home. Invitation to Thanksgiving from whole family - decided suddenly to accept it. Wrote to Uncle Geo. & to Pater to that effect - went to Boston at 1:53, after cloak & ticket - In evening with the Townsend's, Mary Beattie & Ellen Burrell.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
to hear Gen. Wm Booth, of the Salvation Army - came out at 11:15
Tues. 23 Classes as usual. Took 2:42 train for South Framingham, thence to Worcester, thence towards home - Good night on sleeper - changed at
Wed. Buffalo, 6:30 - had a pleasant traveling companion part of the way. Mr. Bush, of N.Y. City, who went to Europe last summer with his own yacht - Home about 12:30, Pater at station - Ethel arrived at 2. Wi & Mary at 9. Made candy in evening - talked over the Oberlin Foreign Missionary Volunteers in family conclave.
Thurs. Thanksgiving Day - Wi, Mary, John, Ethel, Harry, Net, Ralph, Harl & I & Geo, Wilbur went to church - Mr. Garvin preached - Dinner - Went (8 of us) to train with Geo. Wilber, then to call on Aunt Anna, Uncle Doctor & Lizzie - Annie Rich & Mr. Leadingham

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
came in evening - Several of us walked home with Annie - and ate celery, cream, doughnuts & pumpkin pie. Uncle Eliab, Aunt Mollie & Irv came in during the day - also Edith & Flo while we were gone. Sang much - I went over to see Flo & the baby -
Fri. 26 Wi went home in morning - Mary, John, Harl, Ethel, Harry & I went to Oberlin on early train - saw Prof. Jewett, went to Pres. Fairchild's Theology Lecture, called on the boys at their room, dinner at Mr. West's - called on Mrs. Shafer - back on noon train - Mary, John & I went to Aunt Anna's to tea -
Sat. 27 Oberlin children came home at noon. Wi came over - had family group picture taken at Mr. Clark's - quite an event. Harl, Annie, Ba & I went in to see Little Helpers on way home - all together again in evening.
Sun. 28. All together - 12 of us at church -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
I stayed to Sunday School - Harl led the Young People's Meeting - 4 went to evening service -
Mon. 29 Started at 7:26 for W.C. - Harl, Harry & Wi left earlier - Mary went with me as for as Cleveland - An uninteresting journey - Rain - took sleeper at Buffalo - went to bed just beyond Syracuse -
Tues. 30  Waited 1/2 hr at Worcester, where I ate some breakfast & 1 1/4 hors at South Framingham, where I took 2 walks & almost lost my new silk umbrella - Reached Wellesley at 10, & spent the day as usual on Tuesdays - except that being very sleepy, I took a nap in P.M. Wrote letter home -
Wed. Dec. 1 Classes as usual. studied & worked on KMnO4 for Quant. Class. Wrote to Miss Eaton and to Edith. Letter from Uncle George - went to Village in P.M bought some Ivory Soal & Babbitt's Soap. Prayer meeting in evening.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Thurs. 2 Cold winter weather. Expected to lead prayer meeting this evening, but found Miss Lucia Clark in the chair when I went to the chapel. Simon & I went and played a game of letters with Miss Horton in the afternoon. 
Fri. 3 Cold again - high wind - Began KMno4 in Quant. Class at 1:30 - went to see Mrs. Manly. In evening Simon and I called on the Townsend's for a few minutes. Studied Geology in evening - Quant. Anal. in morning - went to see Miss Freeman.
Sat. 4 Geology as usual. Standardized the KMnO4 solution. Had a call from a Mr. Bristol who represented Henry Hold & Co. Helped Miss Talbot prepare a chemical test for her sanitary science lecture. Letter from Pater. Went in evening with Miss Corran and Miss Roberts to Boston to a Ma[[?]] Meeting of Labor Party in Faneuil Hall where we heard Henry George, Geo. McNeil, Labor Candidate for Mayor of Boston - Carlton Brady & Chamberlain - Back on late train.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Sun. 5 Snowstorm. went to church in Village. Slept a little in P.M. Communion Service at College. Dr. Rouen Thomas preached.
Mon. 6 Went to Boston at 8:15 - walked to station in deep snow - Did shopping - went to noon meeting at Beacon Hill Place - & with Eliz. Eliza to see Miss Eaton in P.M. waited long for a Newton Car - & reached W. C. finally about 7:45. Spent most of evening eating some supper in room.
[note in margin: Mr. Horace Scudder lectured in evening on Domestic Life in Shakespeare]
Tues. 7 Snow, more of it - walked to Village in some rather hard (or soft) walking - & had to change all my clothes on return - Letter from Mr. Root - also one from Pater - very brief - wrote twice to Mr. Root - once home. No Faculty Meeting on account of the storm -
Wed. 8 Beautiful weather - air delicious - Took quite a walk with Simon in Morning immediately after chapel - Classes as on Wed. Prayer meeting led by Miss Currier -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
read Geology & knitted.
Thurs. 9 Beautiful clear mild weather. Henry M. Stanley lectured in Boston this evening. Letter from Annie 7 one from Mrs. Seymore - M. Marsh & I went down to the Industrial Sale at the Town Hall. To supper. Came back about 8 o'clock.
Friday 10 Another fine day. Wrote to Annie & to Uncle George - sent Gold Ink to Edith - studied [[?Ferri & Ferro Cyams]] - etc - Head Meeting this evening, brief - Miss Freeman & Miss Hallowell have gone to Dr. Lear's Funeral -
Sat. 11 Geology class as usual - went to bed thereafter - Made questions for Geog. Examinations, Phys. & Mod - Read some in Harper's.
Sun. 12 Did not get up to breakfast - nor to church - went to 5 o'clock prayer meeting, supper & chapel. Rev. Mr. Howes, father of the Howe's girls here, preached today.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Mon. 13. Rainy weather - quite dismal - Mended hose etc. Went to Soph. Reception to Mrs. Goodwin & Phillips Brooks in afternoon - made chem. questions - pupil's concert in evening -
Tues. 14 Examinations at 9:00 & 1:30 - Faculty Meeting in evening - Family Picture arrived on night mail - fine - went to Village in P.M.
Wed. 15 - went to prayer meeting & spoke not - Quant. class at 11:45 - did some arithmetic thereat -
Thurs. 16 Big snowstorm - Went to see Mrs. Manly & show the picture, in P.M. Mr. Alpheus Hardy told the story of Nees[[?]]a here this evening -
Fri. 17 Class at 9 - Went to Boston at 11:07 - back on 5 o'clock train. Prof Kohn (?) of Harvard lectured & Mdlle. See gave him a reception - Miss Talbot gave her last Sanitary Science lecture -
Sat. 18 Went to Millbury at 2:16 -0 Rain, rain - Rode with May Sleeper to Mill-

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
bury - Prof. Lauciani lectures at 3:45 as on Thursday -
Sun. 19. In Millbury - Lovely weather Uncle George preached in the Baptist Ch. & I went there with him - there to S.S. - Prayer meeting in evening & talk thereafter -
Mon. 20 Mrs. Thayer & Paul came up to talk about Oberlin - Paul went to Worcester with me at 1. I did not find Mrs. Jones at home nor on the street - took 4 o'clock train fr. Worcester to Wellesley - Prof. Paliner of Harvard read from the Odyssey I wr[[?]]t not - Good joke about our Les - Found letters fr. Pater & Annie - wrote to Annie - sent Gold [[?]]  - Gold cord & 2 pictures -
Tues. 21 Classes as usual - 
Wed. 22 Quantitative class - Miss Crudit only, at 11:45. Term closed at 12:30 Things seem a little dismal evening - M. Marsh went at 1:53.

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Thurs. Went to Boston at 7:15 A.M. came out at 2:15. Went to see Dr. Helen Morton - did some Christmas shopping.
Fri. 24 Sent off some Christmas things - Began to study the crystal foudn in P.M. Rain.
Sat. 25 Christmas Day - Fine weather - Mended stockings in A.M. Dinner lasted 2 hrs - Went on foot to see Simon after dinner, Miss Welch * Miss Ferris accompanying - German Christmas tree in evening - supper at 8. Charades in parlor - Letter from Elizabeth Eliza - Book fr. Mr. Jones & Miss Emerson - Card fr. Edith Picture fr. Jo Cass - Card fr. Miss Kelsey.
Sun. 26 Fine weather still. Went to church & Sunday School. Did not go out in evening. We sang hymns in the parlor after prayers. 
Mon. 27 Gray morning with some snow. clear in P.M. Sent off my bundle home -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Letter from Pater - Back from Mr. Cowan - Christmas book from Neiba Breckenridge, also one from Miss Stobridge - worked on crystallography in P.M. Postal from M. Marsh - 
Tues. 28 Studied
Wed. 29 Studies went to Boston 10 - 11:30 -
Thurs. 30 Studied - Carrie Soule & I went to Mrs. Horton's & Mrs. Manley's - snowstorm - 
Fri. 31. Went to see Katherine at Stone Hall. Studied on Speciueus - 
Sat. Jan. 1. Raid - ice - slush. Went to Boston at 1:53 & out to Winchester - after hearing Dr. Meredith - Crossings almost bottomless - Letter from Anna Rich
Sun. 2. In Winchester. Bright cold day Went to church, S.S. communion service, & Missionary Meeting.
Mon. 3 Clear & cold - slippery. Read Jo's Boys, in Winchester. Left for Boston at 2:58. Took supper at 291 Columbus Ave. with Elizabeth Eliza & her family - & went to Lowell Institute

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Lecture - "Chemistry of Iron & Steel Ma[[?]]" in evening - came out on 9 o'clock train - stinging cold. 5 below 0 - & high wind - found my rooms very hot. had to cool off some time before go to bed - Letter from Pater & one from Flo Mussey Metcalf - Box not arrived - 
Tues. Studied - Went to prayer meeting in Village in evening with Edith Sturges. Box arrived about suppertime, candy, silk mittens, Maya's book & other good things - 
Wed. Dusted room - mended - clean up in general. Studied & considered on Gen Chem. Went to Boston at 5 - was the only lady at the chemistry lecture - Came out at 10 - Miss Jackson was on train with me both ways - M. Marsh came this P.M. - Marion Jewett is somewhat laid up with a sore foot -
Thurs. Term began - I did not get up to breakfast nor teach my g[[?]]lock

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
class - we saw Prof. Niles - taught 1:30 class - Hydrogen experiments - rather miserable after it - did not to go dinner -
Friday - Classes as usual - Prayer meeting in evening - Letters yesterday fro Carrie Post, Annie - Jeanie McMartin - invitation to song recital by Mr. Frank Morse - ansered Miss McMartin's letter this afternoon - Note From Mrs. Watson, in Chelsea, about sleigh ride - 
Sat. 8 Geol. Quiz - only 4 names for Mineralogy - perhaps shall have no class - Studied Quant. Anal - went to walk with Carrie Soule & Simon - Cold weather - Letter from Pater on late mail - wrote to Mrs. Watson - 
Sun. 9 Cold - snow in evening - went to church & S.S. in Village - heard Dr. Wordworth preach a very impressive sermon for the A.M.A. taught Mrs. Dana's S.S. class -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
went to Young People's Meeting in evening Marion Bennett sick E.E. spent most of the day with her -
Mon. 10 Went to Boston at 11 - & went first to see Dr. Morton - dinner at Casius - went to Holiness Meeting at Wesleyan Hall Had to spend afternoon in some way till time for Prof. Drown's lecture - found there was no lecture. Went with E.E. & K.K. then, to a Young People's Meeting wh. we discovered in Warren Avenue Church - came out at 9 - Wrote to Miss McElurr - 
Tues. 11 Wrote letter home - Classes as usual - Meeting of Academic Council in evening to make schedule of Examinations - 
Wed. 12 Sleigh Ride in P.M. - with Mrs. Safford, Mrs. Watson & Simon - fine fun - Prayermeeting led by Miss Lucia Clarke - wrote to Reichardt & to J. Bishop & Co
Thurs. 13 Appointed Comm - on Miss Robert's 2nd degree - Wrote to Miss Eaton - Sir William Dawson +c here - also Mrs. Douglass, who presented The Backwoodsman, who arrived yesterday & is on the south porch -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Friday 14 Rain & snow. Saw Miss Freeman about Mineralogy, but then are now 6 people who want to study it. Went to prayer meeting in Village - Quantitative Class Through to 3:10 - 
Sept. 15 Dr. Ordonnaun gave at 4, the first of a course of lectures on "Law" - Administration law. We mended in evening & read Mrs. E. Lyman Lintou's article on "Higher Education of Women" - Last Geology quiz -
Sun. 16 A beautiful winter day - went to church, S.S. & Young People's Meeting in village - taught Mrs. Dana's class again - went to 5 oclock meeting at College - Bishop Paddock preached here, baptized several & confirmed several - 
May 17 Gave Chem. Examinations to Miss Faulds, Nourse, Stevens, Miller - corrected papers - Marion Peltou came to see me - wrote letter home - went to Boston at 5 - supper at Macdonald's. then to Prof. Drown's lecture through rain, snow & slippery streets - then we heard Sam Jones for 1/2 an hour - & took 9 oclock train out -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Tues. Classes as usual. Last Geol. lecture - Faculty meeting in evening till after 10 -
Wed. Interviewed the 5 conditioned girls & one other - made Geol. questions - gave Geol. Ex - 
went to Boston at 5 - Marion Bennett went home tonight. her father came for her. Heard Sam Joines again after Prof. Drown's lecture - 
Thurs. Quant. Work in A.M. - Geol papers in afternoon - did not quite finish them - went to Annual Meeting Reunion of Wellesley Cong. Ch. in evening with Miss Cooley & Miss Grace Darling
Fri - Geol. Ex - to MIss Sheldon and Miss Barrett - Finished papers & made marts +c - went to prayer meeting in Village with Grace Darling - 
Sat. Warm weather - Quant. Work, Note Books +c - Dr. Ordonnaun's lecture on "Courts" at 4 - Prof Palmer's reading for Odyssey at 7 - Letter from Pater & one from Prof Niles about his

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
box of diagrams -
E.E. on bed most of day - Simon went to Auburndale for Sunday - A spring like day - walking very bad indeed - icy & wet - went to church in Village - heard Dr. Baldwin's missionary talk in afternoon - went to bed about 9 oclock -
Monday Jan. 24 Rain, rain - wrote to Pater & Ethel also to Lottie Roberts - mended stockings - went to Boston at 1:53 heard Sam Small in afternoon, did a little shopping, had supper, spent an hour or so in Reading Room of the Women's Educational & Industrial Union. Then went to Prof. Drown's Lecture - was the only lady there - heard Sam Small for a few minutes after the lecture - He preached in the afternoon on "Whom say ye that I am?" in evening - "He that believth no is condemned already"
Tues. 25 Bright day - Quant. Anal. & Lab - Note Books - Academic Council Meeting from 6:30 - 10 P.M. Wrote to Harl -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Wed. 26 Snow and rain. Note Books - Helen Sanborn here. Katherine Bates came to see me - went to Boston at 5. Prof. Horford sat with me on the train. Marion Marsh & I heard Sam Small for a few minutes after Prof. Drown's lecture. He told the story of his life - very thrilling - we had dinner at noon -
Thurs. 27 Day of Prayer for College - a beautiful bright day - Miss Steward and Miss Slater told Sam Small's story to us at dinner table. Phillips Brooks preached at 3 P.M. on Christ's conversation with the blind man. "Dost thou believe on the Son of God?" "Who is He, Lord, that I might believe on Him?" "It is He that talketh with thee." Lord, I believe - A wonderful prayermeeting in the evening -\
Friday 28 Rain again. Snow nearly gone. Ice & water. Long letter from Pater - worked at Quant, & M[[?]] - Put books

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
in our new bookcase - Went to prayermeeting in Village with Miss Darling -
Sat. 29 Pater's birthday - 65 years old - First Mineralogy lesson at 10:55. just 6 in the class. Went to lunch & then went to bed. Some misery in the evening. Note fr. Mrs. Watson. She cannot come to the Reception - Mr and Mrs DePew will probably come. [note in margin: Rain]
Sun. 30 rain - Fog - Mist - on bed most of day. Misses Emerson, Marsh, Kelsey, Fuller, Howes, Condit, Sperry , Cooley & Mrs Ransom came to see me - also Dr. Speakman  - went to chapel in evening for a few minutes - Rev. Fred Palmer Epis - brother of Prof. Palmer of Harvard, preached.
Jan. 31 Did Note Books in A.M. - did not go to breakfast - Reception in P.M. Mr & Mrs DePew came with Mr & Mrs Damon & Mary Dannon from Concord - I had very nice time with them - Had also a good talk with Dr. Judson Smith - went

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
to Boston at 5. Prof Honford sat with me on train & introduced me to Prof John Williams White of Harvard. Went to supper at the Reiner House with Helen Sanborn and was a few minutes late to Prof. Drown's lecture - heard Sam Jones for a few minutes & came out on 9 oclock train - [Note in margin: Beautiful weather - letter from Ethel & one from Cassius Caius -
Tues. Feb 1 Gray in the A.M. - clear in P.M. - Cold - 3 classes - Mineralogy at 10:55 - Faculty Meeting in evening - subject of class organization discussed - wrote to Pater - finished up Note Bks - of 1:30 class -
Wed. 2 Snow. Went to Boston at 3:39 - first to see Dr. Morton - then did a little shopping, had supper at Macdonald's & went to Lecture, alone - Mr. Sherman Denton entertained me on the train, coming out. 
Thurs. 3 Mineralogy class omitted today - others as usual - went to Boston at 3:39 with Edith Harris - met at station by Mr. Hayes - took dinner at Boston Universi-

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
ty - Club Dining Room of Theologues with little Captain Harding & her husband. Mr & Mrs Young - had a fine time - went to lecture, the first in the Valumetive Analysis Course - very elementary - met Mr Frank Davidson at Columbus Ave. Station - walked up fr. train -
Fri. 4 Quant. Class on Iodinetry at 3:10. Took 5:05 train to Boston - had a rather bad supper at the Casino - went to Lecture - on the Direct Process of making Wrought Iron - could not get into People's Church after it - met on train a Miss Zeal, student at Lasell, who boarded at Jennie Hall's two summers ago. Dr. Abbott lectured at 2:15. Nellie Brown Giles was here in P.M. Beautiful evening - rings of color around the moon -
Sat. 5 Letter from Pater - Mineralogy class at 10:55 - Trying to arrange for Chlorine Classes for next week -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Finished yesterday's examination papers of 9 oclock class. very poor. Table came up after silent time. Read story of a Short Life. Went to Wellesley Library with Simon after dinner - Dr. Abbott spoke at 4 - Mended stockings.
Sun. 6 Gray sky all day. Went to church & Sunday School in Village. Taught Mr. Dana's class - went to Dr. Abbott's Bible Meeting here in evening - subject - Ps. 103.
Mon. 7 Went to Boston at 11:07 & found there were no Sam Jones' meetings. Went into the Holiness Meeting at Wesleyan Hall to pass away the time. Prof. Drown's lecture in the evening. introduced ourselves to him afterwards with fear & trembling - he was very pleasant - corrected papers of 9 oclock class -
Tues. 8 Meeting of Academic Council in evening - classes as usual -
Wed. 9 Chlorine class at 4. all somewhat choked. Board of Visitors here today - Eliza-

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
Eliza & I took dinner with them - scalloped oysters, salad +c - I went in with Mr. Marble. Went to Boston at 5 - met with Eaton on the train & had supper with her at Macdonald's then to Prof. Drown's lecture - Miss Eaton would not get to Cambridge as usual on account of the strike on the hon[[?]] line - Fine weather -
Thurs. 10 Rain - Miss Howes led prayermeeting in evening - went to bed before 10 oclock - Almost went to Boston to Vol. Anal. lecture -
Fri. 11 Rain - Quant. Class omitted - Went to Boston at 12:15, but did not succeed in hearing Sam Jones - HeardRev. Mr. Ela preach at People's Church went to dinner at Adams House with Mddle. Sie - Last lecture in Prof. Drown's Course this evening -
Sat. 12 Fine day - Mineralogy class - finished Crystallography - went to Natick in evening to hear Sam Jones at a Temperance Meeting - House of Commons

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
at College this evening. 
Sunc 13 Fine cold weather - went to ch. S.S. & young People's Meeting in Village - Simon home over Sunday - Dr. Griffis preached at College - The Pandita Ramabai Saraswati spoke in the evening -
Mon. 14 Labored by day - mended [[?clorties]] - letter from home - Concert by Choir of Church of the Advent in evening - many, many people - Geog. Exam -
Tues. 15 Gave Min. class a Written Lesson - went to Boston with Simon to Prof Pope's Vol. Anal. Lecture - back on 9 oclock train -
Wed. 16 Miss Slater's birthday - flowers & Maccaroons at breakfast - went to village with Simon - Read book from Henry Holt & Co - Miss Kelsey sick with headache - warm weather
Thurs. 17 Mineralogy lesson on Lustre, Cleavage, Structure +c. Prayer Meeting led by MIss Whiting - Simon & I went to see the Baldwins in the afternoon -

title: Marion Metcalf diary [04], 1883-1889
transcription:
